title: Zero Conditional: Cause and Effect — Quiz 83
content:
## Zero Conditional: Cause and Effect

Choose verb forms for facts and general truths.

### Lesson focus

1. If you ___ butter, it melts. (heat / will heat)
2. Students ___ fast if the teacher is competent. (learn / will learn)
3. If a young plant doesn't get water, it ___ . (dies / will die)
4. If you ___ harder, you feel happier. (will work / work)

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
